items.title: Advanced Tests: F-Test and Chi-Square Test (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Advanced Tests: F-Test and Chi-Square Test' under topic 7.4 (PDF 98-100, printed 94-96).

blocks.text: Advanced tests pecheeda data sambhalte hain. F-test variances (phailao) ka muqabla karta hai aur analysis of variance (ANOVA) mein use hota hai. Chi-square test rishte (relationships) check karta hai aur categorical data (qismon mein bata hua data) ke saath use hota hai. Yeh tests gehra analysis karte hain, sakht qawaid par chalte hain, aur inhein samajhne se maharat aur ilm barhta hai.
F-test ki misaal:
Yahan:
Misaal:
Farz karein talaba ke do groups hain:
Sample 1 ka variance = 16
Sample 2 ka variance = 9
Nikali hui F-value (1.78) ko F-table ki critical value se milaya jata hai, taake faisla ho ke dono variances mein numayan farq hai ya nahi.
Misaal:
Numerical example: hypothesis testing
Ek school dekhna chahta hai ke kya parhane ke naye tareeqe ne talaba ke marks behtar kiye hain. Pehle average marks 70 the.
Naye tareeqe se parhe 10 talaba ke sample ne yeh marks liye:
Qadam 1: Hypotheses likhein
Null hypothesis (H₀): Naya tareeqa marks behtar nahi karta (μ = 70).
Alternative hypothesis (H₁): Naya tareeqa marks behtar karta hai (μ > 70).
Qadam 2: Significance level tay karein
Qadam 3: Sample mean nikalein (tamam marks jama kar ke 10 par taqseem)

blocks.text_alt: x̄ = tamam qeematon ka jama / n = 770/10 = 77

blocks.text: Qadam 4: Standard deviation nikalein (har mark ka 77 se farq le kar us ka murabba (square) karein; in murabbon ka jama 70 hai)
Qadam 5: t-value nikalein
Qadam 6: Faisle ka qaida (decision rule)
t-distribution table ya statistical software se t = 7.93 aur df = 9 ke liye one-tailed p-value taqreeban 0.000012 (1.2 × 10⁻⁵) aati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab p = 0.00002 chhapti hai. Yeh two-tailed (dono taraf wali) p-value hai. Lekin H₁ kehta hai μ > 70, yani test one-tailed (sirf ek taraf ka) hai, is liye sahi p-value taqreeban 0.000012 hai. Dono suraton mein p 0.05 se bohat chhoti hai, is liye faisla (H₀ reject) nahi badalta.
df = 9 par p-value bohat chhoti hai (p < 0.05).
Qadam 7: Nateeja
Kyunke p-value < α, hum null hypothesis reject karte hain.
Aakhri nateeja: Parhane ka naya tareeqa talaba ke marks numayan tor par behtar karta hai.
Khud chala kar dekhein
Yeh program upar wali numerical example ko statistics library se hal karta hai: mean, standard deviation, t-value aur faisla. marks ki list ya mu badal kar Run karein.

import math
import statistics

marks = [72, 75, 78, 74, 77, 80, 76, 79, 81, 78]   # naye tareeqe wale talaba
mu = 70          # pehle ka average (H0: mu = 70)
t_table = 1.833  # df = 9, alpha = 0.05, one-tailed (table se)

n = len(marks)
x_bar = statistics.mean(marks)
s = statistics.stdev(marks)          # n - 1 se taqseem wala standard deviation
t = (x_bar - mu) / (s / math.sqrt(n))
print("n =", n, "| mean =", x_bar, "| s =", round(s, 2))
print("t =", round(t, 2), "| df =", n - 1)
if t > t_table:
    print("t critical value se bara: H0 reject")
else:
    print("t critical value se chhota: H0 reject nahi")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import math", "import statistics": square root aur mean/standard deviation ke tayyar functions.
"marks = [...]": 10 talaba ke marks; "mu = 70": pehle ka average (H₀: μ = 70).
"t_table = 1.833": t-table se df = 9 aur α = 0.05 (one-tailed) ki critical value; t is se bara ho to critical region mein hai.
"n = len(marks)": 10. "statistics.mean(marks)": 770 ÷ 10 = 77. "statistics.stdev(marks)": sample standard deviation (n − 1 = 9 se taqseem) = √(70/9) ≈ 2.79.
"t = (x_bar - mu) / (s / math.sqrt(n))": (77 − 70) ÷ (2.79 ÷ √10). Program poore decimals se hisab karta hai, is liye 7.94 aata hai; kitab beech mein 0.88 tak gol (round) kar ke ≈ 7.93 likhti hai.
"round(s, 2)": 2 decimal tak. "if t > t_table:" faisla.
Output: "n = 10 | mean = 77 | s = 2.79", "t = 7.94 | df = 9" aur "t critical value se bara: H0 reject".
Khud try karein: mu = 76 karein: t ≈ 1.13 aayega jo 1.833 se chhota hai, is liye "t critical value se chhota: H0 reject nahi".

blocks.alt: Das number 68 se 82 tak ki number line ke oopar nuqton ki shakal mein, 78 par do nuqte. Dashed surkh line purana mean 70 (H0) aur sabz line namoone ka mean 77. Dabba hal: n = 10, jama 770, mean 77, s = sqrt(70 / 9) = 2.79; t = 7 / 0.88 = 7.93, df = 9; p < 0.05, is liye H0 radd aur naye tareeqe ne number barhaye.
blocks.caption: Parhane ke tareeqe wali misaal (kitab ki misaal par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Dason number 70 se oopar aur aik doosre ke qareeb hain, isi liye t itna bara hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar misal mein namoone ka mean wahi standard deviation ke saath 71 hota to t kya hota, aur kya H0 phir bhi radd hota (df = 9 par alpha = 0.05 ki one-tailed critical value 1.83 hai)?
blocks.explanation: t = (71 - 70) / 0.88 = 1.13. Kyunke 1.13 < 1.83, t critical region mein nahi aur H0 radd nahi hota: aik number ka izafa ittifaq ho sakta hai.

F = S₁²/S₂² variances milata hai (16/9 = 1.78); chi-square categorical data ke rishte check karta hai.
Misaal: mean 77, s ≈ 2.79, t ≈ 7.93, p ≈ 0.000012 < 0.05, is liye H₀ reject.
